speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Set the loaf to the notch, Alse, and do not argue with the board. My husband's notch, cut in a good year, and it does not move.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: It comes short, mistress. A finger. The same as Friday.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A penny still, and short by a finger. Mark me. I am not paying two pence to feel honest about a smaller loaf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I would not have you. A penny is the price.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Your sixpence for firing and washing is entered. Michaelmas to Lady Day, and we are in the middle of it. Sixpence, and not a farthing on top for the river damp.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Entered, then. I will not ask you to name it kindness.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The cat is on the book again. The one with the red edges. I will not shift him. He bites the honest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him. That book can bear a cat for one Sunday. I am not at it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Board is threepence if you sit. You are sitting. That is a meal.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then put me down for it. I am not a guest in the passage.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I take the same threepence, mistress. Sunday the loom is still. I eat what you set.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You eat, Master Verbeke, and you do not bring the street up the stair. That was the bargain.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: There is pottage, and the end of yesterday's mutton. The loaf is the small thing on the board, not the dinner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The small thing is the one she measures. She is right to.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Thursday. You open the new one. I ruled it in January, and I have not gone back on myself.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four young men who cannot keep an oath past a dinner. You said so.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I said they swear off women and keep it till dinner, and that I believe. If Thursday makes them wiser, you may tell me after, while you are carrying something.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The ladies have the better of it. That is the part I would have you hear, if you hear any.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Do the ladies get the dinner, sir?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Alse. Plates.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They get the last word, which is a colder portion, and a better one.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: In my trade the last thread is the one that holds. I do not know plays.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Nor should you, on a Sunday. Master Shakespeare writes his letter after this, and the house stays quiet for it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: After three. The carrier is not this week. The sheet can wait in the room.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then eat the short loaf and do not make a sermon of it. Master Thwaite has had the glass twice already. This house will not have a third.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I have put your candle by the desk. One. You count your own after that.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One is enough to start. Thank you, Alse.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And if Gib has chosen the cushion from home, leave it. The cat is only heavy.
